name: Seated Straddle Stretch
steps: Sit upright on the floor and spread your straight legs out wide into a comfortable V straddle with your toes and kneecaps pointing upward.
Place your hands on the floor in front of you and hinge slowly forward from your hips while keeping your back long.
Walk your hands gently forward until you feel a clear stretch across your inner thighs and hamstrings.
Hold the stretch calmly with slow breaths, then walk your hands back in gently to sit upright.
tips: Sit on a folded towel if your pelvis tilts backward and rounds your lower back.
Keep your toes pointing toward the ceiling rather than letting your feet flop inward.
